composition_variation: Create an original 35-year-old anime woman with closely cropped silver hair, seated on a low bench in a peaceful futuristic greenhouse. She wears a fully sealed opaque white civilian spacesuit with teal joints, holding her clear helmet on one knee. Use luminous sci-fi watercolor, pale green plants, brushed silver surfaces, and soft earthlike daylight. Her mature face is calm and capable, with no logos or militarized equipment. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
